semiconductor_relevance: High — the company specializes in inspection and measurement equipment for integrated circuit production management.
summary: Dongfang Jingyuan Electron Co., Ltd. develops advanced inspection and measurement solutions for semiconductor manufacturing, focusing on yield management through defect detection and critical dimension measurement. Their innovative tools utilize electron beam imaging technology to enhance the quality and efficiency of integrated circuit production.
capabilities: Electron beam imaging for defect detection

regional_presence.China: The company is headquartered in Beijing Yizhuang Economic and Technological Development Zone.
